label: ACCEPT
reason: Every codemod default export is built via createTransformer, directly or through factories (removeFacade, addAwaitFn, removeAwaitFn); all listed exemptions are lib helpers/definitions. Nothing in tsconfig or .oxlintrc.json requires it (jscodeshift accepts any plain transformer function, and the scaffold template even emits one), so a plain-function codemod would silently skip the shared context/messages/null-return handling; worth flagging. Hesitated with WRONG mixed_group because the scope also covers lib helpers and wording ignores factory members.
defects: packages/codemod/scripts/scaffold-codemod.ts:40 scaffold template generates a plain transformer, not createTransformer
